verdict.rationale: Ramp provides a public developer API with OpenAPI spec, LLM-friendly docs (llms.txt/llms-api.txt), an official CLI, and an official MCP server, all of which let AI-native developers build against Ramp programmatically. However, no evidence of dedicated language SDKs (e.g. Python/Node client libraries) is present—only raw API/OpenAPI access plus CLI/MCP tooling. Missing for 10: official first-party SDK packages in specific languages, independent developer corroboration of SDK usage.
